customManagers.description: Bump the team-management Harbor image tags to the latest platform-idp release. Harbor (harbor.127.0.0.1.sslip.io) is a local, self-signed registry Renovate can't reach, so versions are resolved from the PUBLIC platform-idp git tags (the single unified vX.Y.Z release that builds all teams-* images) and rewritten into the Harbor image line.

packageRules.description: All three teams-* images share the unified version, so group them into one PR.
